Seasonal Effects for the Wealdwoods
Sheltered By The Storm
When the worst of the rain hammers the canopy above, a Traveler might feel themselves protected from nature's fury as they huddle 
beneath the towering trees of the Wealdwoods. While safe from the strike of lightning or pelting hail, they may still be at the mercy of 
the changing seasons that affect the flora and fauna within. From new growths that urge migrating beasts to travel, to blooming fungi 
that spell death for any creature breathing in their drifting spores. 
The Wealdwoods dominate the landscapes they grow upon; the Tanglewood sprawls across most of the east, spreading from the marshy 
Mirewynn to the heights of the Splitspine, while the west harbors isolated sanctuaries of life. Each of these Wealdwoods are home to 
flora and fauna that respond to the changing seasons, either from hibernating through the cold or migrating to the warmth of lower-
lying forests.

Raining Canopy • -2 to Perception (Wisdom) checks that 
rely on sight or hearing beyond 30 ft.. All Fire damage 
rolls have a –1 damage penalty. Negate the benefits of a 
Long Rest for a Traveler if they have no adequate cover 
from the rain.
Clear Skies • Calm weather with no effects.
Lively Streams • ±1 to the Range Result on a Fishing 
Expedition.
Underbrush Overgrowth • Plant life grows in a tangle of 
vines and bushes, obscuring paths and blocking travel. 
Travelers and creatures not native to the Wealdwoods 
treat the Wealdwoods as Difficult Terrain and move at 
half their movement speed.
Low Lying Mist • A heavy mist lies along the ground. 
Visibility is reduced to 30 ft., Travelers and Creatures gain 
Advantage on Wisdom (Stealth) checks to Hide.
Sunken Woods • Spring floods cover vast expanses of the 
forest in shallow water. Any Tracking, Wisdom (Survival) 
checks are made with Disadvantage.
Verdant Growth • Thick spheres of dropmoss fruit 
glisten in the soft moss, fresher and easier to harvest 
than any other season. Any Foraging Expeditions will 
yield double the result for Dropmoss Fruit.

Iron Harvest • Ironwood glints metallic in the heat of 
summer, making it easier to distinguish them from other 
trees within the Wealdwoods. Any Foraging Expeditions 
will yield double the result for Ironwood.

Leaf Litter • Fallen leaves crunch with each footfall within 
the Wealdwoods. Travelers gain Advantage on Wisdom 
(Survival) checks to Track, but have Disadvantage on 
Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Fungal Decay • As the growth of plants wane, fungi wax 
vigorously. Hollowmold spreads in the dark recesses of 
the Wealdwoods. Travelers roll a 1d20 when attempting 
a Short or Long Rest within the Wealdwoods, on a result 
of a 1 they rested too near a patch of hollowmold and take 
3d6 Necrotic Damage and do not benefit from the Rest.
Gripping Vines • Crawvine pull at the leaf litter desperately 
to fuel itself for the wintering months. Crawvine Natural-
Traps will be encountered more frequently.
Silken Dust • The duskwing butterfly cocoons along tree 
trunks in the fading light of winter. Duskspun Cocoons 
Natural-Traps will be encountered more frequently.
Whispersnuff Pollen • The humid air is thick with orange 
pollen. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, any Traveler in 
the Wealdwoods for more than an hour. Failure: They 
violently sneeze, alerting nearby scavengers. Roll once on 
the Scavengers table and resolve any result.

Cover from the Cold • The sullen gray moss of dropmoss 
grows heavily on the tree branches, easily seen in the 
barren winter. Any Foraging Expeditions will yield double 
the result for Dropmoss Bundles.
Falls Thorn • Rising on twisting vines, the sweet thorned 
garnet is at its ripest during the fall. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the result for Thorned 
Garnet.
Tracks in the Snow • A fresh layer of snow blankets the 
woods, leaving clear imprints of any that passed through 
recently. Any Wisdom (Survival) checks to Track have 
Advantage.
Winter
Lethal Steps • Fel Floret plants proliferate in dangerous 
amounts across the ground during this season. Fel Floret 
Natural-Traps will be encountered more frequently.
Foggy Infestation • Fetaur beetles congregate along the 
underbrush, leaving a yellow smog along the ground. 
Any Tracking Wisdom (Survival) checks and Wisdom 
(Perception) checks that rely on smell are made with 
Disadvantage.
Reactive Dispersal • Seedspear Vines crawl up trees, 
readying to launch their sharp seeds. Seedspear Vine 
Natural-Traps will be encountered more frequently.
Descending Death • Icicles glitter on the frozen boughs. 
At the Keepers discretion, any loud noises or heavy 
winds can cause an icicle to break and fall dangerously. 
A Traveler near a tree rolls a 3d20, any result of a 1 has an 
icicle break off and hit them for 3 (1d6) Piercing damage.
Wind Storm • Branches creak and leaves violently shake 
above as strong winds muffle all sounds. Travelers gain 
Advantage on Stealth checks but have Disadvantage on 
Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
Spring Showers • -1 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that 
rely on sight beyond 60 ft..  All Fire damage rolls have a –1 
damage penalty. 
Seasonal Animal Behavior
Awakening Earth
Korrask stir in the thawing 
soil. Re-roll the first Scavenger 
roll if it results in anything 
but a korrask. Korrask gain 
Advantage to Initiative rolls.
Sweltering Storm
As the humidity rises, so does 
the buzz of countless crested 
quills. Double any found on the 
Expedition Hunt and Scavenger 
Tables and crested quills gain 
Advantage to Initiative rolls. 
Arboreal Snipers
A cacophony of birds sing for 
mates and the ynill are alert 
and hungry. Double any found 
on the Hunt Expeditions and 
Scavenger Tables and ynnil gain 
Advantage to Initiative rolls. 
Once per day, their first Venom 
Spit Ranged Weapon Attack is 
made with Advantage.
Nest Wardens
Aphistus protect their nests 
fearlessly during the spring. 
When Bloodied, they gain 
Resistance to Slashing, 
Bludgeoning and Piercing 
damage for the duration of the 
combat encounter.
Aerial Domination
Skyelarx, benefiting from the 
abundant canopy, spend much 
of the warmer seasons within 
the Wealdwoods. Double any 
found on the Expedition Hunt 
and Scavenger Tables and they 
gain Advantage to Wisdom 
(Perception) checks.
Blazing Speed
The hot weather instills a 
manic agility in the ricatrillisk. 
Ricatrillisk gain the Action: 
Multiattack The ricatrillisk 
can make two Hooked Claws 
attacks.
Gods of the Woods
With summer waning, jhotus 
lumber through the old growth 
woods clearing the way for a 
new spring. When bloodied 
they gain +2 AC. They can use 
the Buried Decay Lair Action 
during this season.
Unseen Hunters
As the leaves change to vibrant 
hues, the elusive shaevrynn 
is even more difficult to spot. 
Re-roll the first of any Hunting 
Expeditions rolls that result in a 
shaevrynn.
Desperate Deer
The sap of trees trickle slowly 
during fall and the fennfistle 
become more bold to get their 
full. Fennfistle gain Advantage 
to their Wisdom Saving Throws.
From Frigid Heights
The feathered calitross thrive 
in the colder seasons. Double 
any found on the Expedition 
Hunt and Scavenger Tables and 
calitross gain Advantage on 
Dexterity (Stealth) checks. 
Dormant Canopy
Ricatrillisk, Crested Quill, 
and Gomitoad hibernate 
during this season. Re-roll the 
first Scavenger or Hunting 
Expeditions rolls if it results in 
a Ricatrillisk, Crested Quill, and 
Gomitoad.
Easy Pickings
With their vibrant “berries” 
easily seen in the bare foliage, 
burberry beetles are found more 
frequently during this season. 
Double any found on the Hunt 
Expeditions and double the 
amount when Scavenging 
Burberry components.
